comment: The document lists financing approaches but could provide more detailed guidance on how DPI-H components integrate with national health insurance (NHI) and public financial management (PFM) systems. This is essential for countries implementing health financing reforms.

public.text: The document lists financing approaches but could provide more detailed guidance on how DPI-H components integrate with national health insurance (NHI) and public financial management (PFM) systems. This is essential for countries implementing health financing reforms.
public.suggestedRevision:
1) Consider adding a sub-section on integration with National Health Insurance (NHI) and Public Finance Management (PFM) systems, detailing: how the Benefits Package Registry and claims management systems interface with existing government financial systems; specific integration patterns for revenue collection, member management, and provider payment; and reference to established frameworks (e.g., WHO health financing guidance, World Bank PFM frameworks). 
2) Include a worked example of a claims flow from eligibility to payment.
